claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: The report shows tanks and totes but not how or where they have been used.

risks.risk: Capacity in liters for each tank or tote
risks.proof: Close-up photos of any embossed liter markings or labels on each tank and tote
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest common size for that type

risks.risk: Age and whether the items are new or used
risks.proof: Photos of manufacture date codes or proof of purchase
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown age

risks.risk: Condition of the plastic (cracks, splits, UV damage)
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of all exterior surfaces, seams, and bottoms

risks.risk: Whether the taps and valves work and are included
risks.proof: Video of water flowing through each tap and valve

risks.risk: Condition of the metal cages (rust, dents)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cage corners, welds, and base

risks.risk: Whether the black tanks have lids and fittings
risks.proof: Photos showing the tops and outlet fittings of each black tank

risks.risk: Whether the circular black item is a tank, liner, or basin and its size
risks.proof: Photo showing the item fully laid out with a measuring tape or size label
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded liner or basin of unknown size

risks.risk: Whether the items have been used for potable water or chemicals
risks.proof: Seller declaration or photos of previous content labels and residue
risks.if_unproven: priced as suitable only for non-potable or chemical use

risks.risk: Whether stands or bases are included
risks.proof: Photo showing any stands or bases together with the tanks

proof_requests: Capacity markings or labels on each tank and tote
Manufacture date codes or proof of age
Close-up photos of plastic condition, especially seams and bottoms
Video of each tap and valve running water
Close-up photos of metal cage rust and dents
Photos of black tank lids and fittings
Photo of the circular black item with dimensions
Statement on prior contents (potable water or chemicals)
Photo of any stands or bases
response.reason: The witness identifies the goods as water tanks and caged totes, so a worst-case price is possible; all missing condition and specification details are listed as risks rather than blocking the valuation.
